summary: Permian Resources Corp filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary, Permian Resources Operating LLC, entered into a new $3.0 billion senior unsecured credit facility, replacing a prior credit agreement. The facility matures April 30, 2031, with an option to extend. Interest rates are based on SOFR or Alternate Base Rate plus a margin tied to credit ratings. The filing is a routine refinancing of credit facilities, not a special situation event.
